Developing an Installation for the Exhibition

The idea is to combine different Creative Technology patterns to showcase some of our learning achievements from this semester. Parts of this Digital Garden will be used to explain how the installation works, while the installation itself serves to explain the purpose of the Digital Garden.

A Motion Visual Generative Projection Audio Installation

Following techniques get combined for the installation:

  • Movement Detection in Touchdesigner
  • Projection Mapping in Touchdesigner
  • Arduino Beginners Workshop
  • TouchDesigner to VCV Rack
  • Manipulating Light
